name: Turnip Adreno 613 dw_noubwc (multiview + FS-double-wave + UBWC-off, RG 55G1)
description: Best self-built Mesa Turnip for the Adreno 613. Three GammaOS changes: (1) multiview forced -> VK 1.3; (2) fragment shaders opt into 128-wide waves (fp32 fragment 42->72 GFLOPS); (3) UBWC framebuffer/texture compression disabled by default because it is a measured net loss on gen6_3 (real-title +7%). Brings Turnip to 93-96% of the stock Adreno blob in 3DMark Wild Life (649 vs 700) and Wild Life Extreme (167 vs 174).
author: TheGammaSqueeze
sourceChanges: ir3.c: fragment shaders forced to double-threadsize when branchstack/regfile/wave-count safe
tu_util.cc: TU_DEBUG_NOUBWC on by default (UBWC net loss on Adreno 613); GAMMA_UBWC env re-enables
verified: RG 55G1 (a28c0e0e), GPU @1010, flashed: 3DMark Wild Life 649 (stock 700, 92.7%), Wild Life Extreme 167 (stock 174, 96%), correct render
